title: The Creator Stack: edit, enhance, and draw for free

intro.headline: Create videos, edit photos, and draw — all open-source.
intro.subhead: LibreCuts, Image Toolbox, and Pocket Paint cover video, photo, and layer-based editing without watermarks or paywalls.

outro.headline: Your creative tools, on your terms.
